frames.missingness: record missingness; never repeat, interpolate, or substitute

tracker.smoke_backend_role: explicit frozen feasibility lower bound; not a silent learned-tracker substitution

points.identity: same center-seeded point identity is propagated through all nine frames; no pair re-detection for the persistent arm

decomposition.articulation: residual after camera and actor-root transforms in actor-box coordinates

smoke_gates_first_16.survival: at least 75% of actor points survive all nine frames in at least 80% centers
smoke_gates_first_16.camera_separation: camera removes >=50% background energy while retaining >=50% actor residual
smoke_gates_first_16.source_consistency: native4K and exact-native-downsample720 agree in gate direction

expanded_128_gate.held_visible_point: at least 20% lower error than pair-local overall and positive in at least 4/5 scenario folds

stop: Any smoke gate failure closes this representation without task fitting; no width, temporal block, router, or human review may be added to rescue it.
